annotation.title_clean: Prime Minister's Order No 009/03 of 07/02/2024 Determining Organisational Structure of Rwanda Information Society Authority
annotation.title_en: Prime Minister's Order No 009/03 of 07/02/2024 Determining Organisational Structure of Rwanda Information Society Authority
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Prime Minister of Rwanda (Office of the Prime Minister)
annotation.venue: Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda, Special of 08/02/2024
annotation.summary_en: Rwandan Prime Minister's Order (trilingual Official Gazette) setting the organisational structure and staffing positions of the Rwanda Information Society Authority (RISA), repealing the 2020 order. Despite the filename, it contains no AI policy or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets RISA organisational structure in an annex, with divisions including Technology Innovation and PKI.
Salaries and benefits follow the structure approved by Cabinet on 20/10/2023.
Repeals Prime Minister's Order No 095/03 of 14/08/2020.
Enters into force on publication in the Official Gazette.
